summary: DNS NOTIFY (RFC 1996) was designed to nudge servers to fetch zone updates. This document generalizes it so a notification can trigger other predefined actions. The notification only prompts the receiver to act sooner than its schedule; it does not carry the data itself.

eli5.summary: A doorbell does not hand you a package; it just tells you to come get it. This lets DNS servers ring the doorbell for more kinds of jobs than just zone copying.
